Previous Resolution     

Sponsors

Categories

A resolution to recognize and celebrate the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States of America.

Documents

Bill Document Formatting Information
The following bill formatting information applies to the 2025-2026 session:
  • New language in an amendatory bill will be shown in bold
  • Language to be removed will be striken
  • Amendments made by the House will be blue
  • Amendments made by the Senate will be red
Senate Introduced Resolution
Introduced Resolutions appear as they were introduced and reflect no subsequent amendments or changes
Senate Adopted Resolution
The Adopted Resolution is the resolution, as introduced, that includes any adopted Senate amendments
